description: Provider-agnostic, AI-review-first MCP server for Bitbucket Cloud.
name: io.github.droplinkperformance/bitbucket-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Bitbucket API token (ATATT), app password, or OAuth access token
environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Atlassian account email (required with API tokens)
environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Default Bitbucket workspace when a tool omits workspace
environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE

environmentVariables.description: LLM backend for analyze_pull_request (openai, anthropic, gemini, bedrock)
environmentVariables.name: LLM_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key when LLM_PROVIDER is openai
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
